name: Magic Hands
question: Magic Hands improves the HEALING OUTPUT of Treat Wounds (d10s instead of d8s, plus a status bonus to healing equal to your level) but grants NO bonus to the Medicine check itself. Should healing-output modifiers like this be surfaced as a star on the Medicine skill (useful at the table, but the star currently reads as "bonus to this check"), or excluded from the situational registry entirely until a dedicated healing-output display exists?
evidence: "When you succeed at a Medicine check to Treat Wounds, you can roll d10s instead of d8s for the healing and add a status bonus to the healing equal to your level."

name: Leshy Familiar Secrets
question: Two calls for you. (1) The Purify Air text in core.json is corrupt — "Creatures within a of the leshy" is missing its radius; what radius should the condition string state? (2) The bonus only exists on days the player selected Purify Air from this feat's three options (they may pick only one at a time) — should the star be shown unconditionally with an "if you selected Purify Air" caveat, or only when the daily familiar-ability choice is recorded?
evidence: "**Purify Air** ... Creatures within a of the leshy gain a +2 circumstance bonus to their saving throws against inhaled poison effects, olfactory effects, or other effects that rely on breathing (such as toxic cloud), at the GM's discretion."

name: Fey Ascension
question: Fey Ascension is a choose-one-of-eight feat and only the Unicorn option grants a typed bonus. Should a choice-gated bonus be listed unconditionally on the star (with the option named in the condition text), or suppressed unless the character's stored Fey Ascension choice is Unicorn?
evidence: "**Unicorn** ... You gain a +2 status bonus to saves against poison and charm effects."

name: Harrow Casting
question: Harrow Casting's bonuses depend on which suit you randomly draw (Key = AC/saves, Book = Recall Knowledge, Star = the willing target's saves). Should all suit outcomes be listed on the star, or only the ones that can hit the character's own stats (Key, Book)? Also: the Star outcome's +2 status to saves only reaches this character when they target themselves.
evidence: "**Key** Some of the magic remains behind, infusing your defenses. Until the start of your next turn, you gain a +1 status bonus to your AC and all saving throws. If your harrow omen is Keys, this increases to a +2 status bonus."

name: Contract Negotiator
question: Two things: (a) what is the exact skill key for Legal Lore in the registry — 'lore:legal', 'lore:legal-lore', or something else? (b) the bonus size scales off your DIPLOMACY proficiency while applying to a LEGAL LORE check — should the star show the character's actual computed value (+1/+2/+3) or the whole ladder as text?
evidence: "When negotiating deals or agreements, you can use Legal Lore in place of Diplomacy to Make an Impression or a Request ... If you are an expert in Diplomacy, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to these checks; if you are a master in Diplomacy, this increases to +2, and +3 if you are legendary."

name: Upset Balance
question: core.json's description has the skill name stripped out ("Attempt an  check") — the link text was lost on import. The prerequisite is 'expert in Athletics', so I read this as an Athletics check; please confirm against AoN before the entry is trusted (and note the description defect for the importer).
evidence: "Attempt an [ ] check against the creature's Reflex DC. ... If you are anchored, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this check." — prerequisites list "expert in Athletics".

name: Magnetic Pinions
question: Impulse attack rolls use the kineticist's spell-attack statistic, so I mapped this to target kind 'spell'. Confirm that 'spell' is the right bucket for impulse attack rolls in this app (rather than 'strikeAttack', which is for weapon Strikes).
evidence: "Make ranged impulse attack rolls against up to three creatures within 60 feet of you; you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your attack roll against any target wearing metal armor or made of metal."

name: Wormskin
question: Wormskin is armour-like rather than a trigger-based bonus: it applies whenever you're unarmored, with its own Dex cap of +3 and rune slots. Should it be starred (matching the existing 'animal-skin' precedent in situationalBonuses.ts) or modelled as innate armour in the AC maths? The AC total is wrong either way until the engine handles unarmored-body-armor.
evidence: "When you're unarmored, your flesh gives you a +2 item bonus to AC with a Dexterity cap of +3."

name: Nosoi's Mask
question: The +1 item bonus comes from a purchasable worn (mask) item, not from the feat itself. Should it be registered on the feat (so it shows even for a character who never bought the mask) or attached to the splendid psychopomp mask item record once the item lane is wired up? Registering it on the feat risks a false-positive star.
evidence: "If you instead pay 50 gp for a splendid psychopomp mask, the mask grants you a +1 item bonus to Intimidation while you are wearing it. Its usage is worn (mask)."

name: Orc Warmask
question: The bonus targets whichever ONE skill matches the warmask source the player picked (Religion/Nature/Arcana/Occultism). A flat feat-id -> bonuses table would star all four skills. Do you want the registry to support choice-keyed entries (feat id + effectChoice value), or is starring all four with an 'if you chose X' condition acceptable?
evidence: "You can spend 1 hour performing a ceremony that costs 50 gp to attune yourself more deeply with your *warmask*. If you do, you gain a +1 item bonus to the associated skill whenever you wear the *warmask*." — associated skill is one of "**The Gods** Religion... **The Land** Nature... **Magic** Arcana... **The Unknown** Occultism"

name: Skull Creeper
question: Same call as Nosoi's Mask: the +1 item bonus belongs to the Splendid Skull Mask item (which core.json already has a descRef to), not to the feat. Register on the feat, or wait for the item lane?
evidence: "If you pay 50 gp for a Splendid Skull Mask, the mask grants you a +1 item bonus to Intimidation; its usage is worn (mask)."

name: Raise a Tome
question: The Recall Knowledge skill depends on which book is currently held (Arcana for a spellbook, something else for another tome). Should this be starred on every skill (skill:'all') with the condition text, on Arcana only (the printed example, correct for the common magus case), or left out until books carry a subject-skill field?
evidence: "While you have a book raised, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and a +1 circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge to identify creatures using a skill related to the subject of the book (Arcana if you're using your spellbook)."

name: Emergency Targe
question: The bonus size is not printed on the feat — it is whatever the wielded shield or the shield spell grants (+1 or +2, higher with a tower shield). Should the display string stay generic ('your shield's circumstance bonus') or resolve from the equipped shield?
evidence: "You immediately Raise a Shield or cast *shield*. The circumstance bonus applies to your defenses when determining the outcome of the triggering attack or spell."

name: Favored Terrain
question: Favored Terrain's speed bonus depends on the terrain the player chose (and on having unimpeded journey). The registry is keyed by feat id only — should this be one combined entry listing all terrain variants, or should the registry gain a per-choice key so only the chosen terrain's speed is starred?
evidence: "you instead gain a +10-foot status bonus to your swim Speed" … "Plains You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your land Speed."

name: Confabulator
question: Confabulator improves your odds without modifying your own check. Should it still get a display-only note on Deception ("repeat Lie / Create a Diversion: the target's bonus drops to +2, +1 at master, none at legendary"), or should records that only shrink an enemy's bonus be excluded from the registry entirely?
evidence: "Reduce the circumstance bonus a target gains for your previous attempts to Create a Diversion or Lie to it from +4 to +2."

name: Whirling Throw
question: This bonus/penalty exists only inside the Whirling Throw action itself (it is not a general Athletics modifier). Do you want action-internal size modifiers starred on the Athletics skill, or is that display noise you would rather keep out of the registry?
evidence: "You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your check if the target is one size smaller than you and a +4 circumstance bonus if it's smaller than that" (and a -2/-4 penalty if larger).

name: Meddling Futures
question: One free action randomly picks ONE of four mutually exclusive benefits (1d4). Six stars would light up at once even though at most one applies on any given use. Do you want all six markers, or a single grouped marker on one representative stat with the 1d4 table in the popup?
evidence: "Roll 1d4 to see what type of spirit is drawn to you. Your next action must be the type of action the spirit prefers, but you also gain the listed benefit" — each of the four results is a different typed bonus.

name: Derring-do
question: This is a fortune reroll, not a typed bonus, and the affected skills vary by which bravado actions the character actually has (Tumble Through = Acrobatics, Demoralize = Intimidation, Feint = Deception, Bon Mot = Diplomacy, ...). Should it be one skill:'all' marker, or should it be expanded per bravado action the character owns?
evidence: "you can roll twice and use the higher result on checks to which the circumstance bonus from Stylish Combatant applies (Tumble Through and any skill actions with the bravado trait)".

name: Swashbuckler's Speed
question: Fold the +5-foot leg into the computed Speed and star only the panache upgrade, or leave both legs as situational markers?
evidence: "Increase the status bonus to your Speeds when you have panache to a +10-foot status bonus; you also gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speeds when you don't have panache."

name: Celebrity Dedication
question: Earn Income can use any of several skills. Star every skill (skill:'all'), or narrow it to Crafting/Performance/Lore?
evidence: "when you Earn Income, if the level of the task is higher than your level, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your check to Earn Income."

name: Endemic Herbs
question: This is a crafting feat whose benefit lands on whoever eats the item — starring it would light up all three saves plus Perception on the crafter's own sheet permanently. Do you want all five markers, or should consumable-granted bonuses be excluded from this registry?
evidence: "When a creature consumes one of your herbal items, that creature gains the benefit matching the location where you created that item" — e.g. "**Aquatic** Gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves".

name: Tweak Appearances
question: The bonus goes to 'the target' — normally an ally, though the feat owner can plausibly tweak their own appearance. Should this feat star the OWNER's Diplomacy/Performance at all, or should it be excluded from the registry until an ally-buff channel exists? (I listed it as a self-bonus on the assumption self-targeting is allowed.)
evidence: "You spend 1 minute making quick adjustments to someone's clothing and appearance ... While speaking to that audience, the target gains a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy and Performance checks. If you have master proficiency in Crafting, the bonus increases to +2; if you have legendary proficiency in Crafting, the bonus increases to +3."

name: Rain of Embers Stance
question: Policy call for every stance/toggle-gated bonus: when a condition is already modelled as an app toggle (stances, modes, rage), should the stat ALSO show a star explaining why the number changes, or should stars be reserved for conditions the app cannot track? I assumed the latter and excluded this feat. The same rule will decide roughly 99 stances.
evidence: "While in Rain of Embers Stance, you gain a +1 status bonus to AC and fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1)." — and the stances collection entry already carries "acBonus":{"value":1,"type":"status"}.

name: Clan's Edge
question: The feat itself grants no new bonus — it only compresses the actions needed to reach the clan dagger's own parry bonus ('the +1 circumstance bonus to your AC FROM your clan dagger's parrying trait'). Should the star be registered on this feat, or on the clan dagger item once the item lane can show markers? Registering it in both places would double-star AC.
evidence: "Make two clan dagger Strikes against different targets ... You then use an Interact action to gain the +1 circumstance bonus to your AC from your clan dagger's parrying trait."

name: Battleforger
question: This is really a temporary +1 potency rune on ONE chosen item, and the app already models potency runes. Should Battleforger be a star, or should it instead be offered as a temporary rune the player applies to a specific item (which would make the numbers real)? As a star it is imprecise — it cannot say WHICH weapon, and it must not appear if every weapon already has a potency rune.
evidence: "By spending 1 hour working on a weapon or armor, you can grant it the effects of a *+1 potency* rune until your next daily preparations, gaining a +1 item bonus to attack rolls for a weapon or increasing armor's item bonus to AC by 1. This has no effect if the weapon or armor already had a *potency* rune."

name: Swordmaster Dedication
question: Two mapping calls. (1) The first bonus is to the Reflex DC (a defence others roll against), not to a Reflex saving throw — is starring Reflex acceptable, or does the sheet need a separate 'save DC' surface? (2) The third entry is a SKILL bonus but I had to reuse strikeAttack because a single record's entries share no way to say 'skill: all' alongside — please re-target it to skill/'all' if that is the intended shape.
evidence: "You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Reflex DC when foes attempt to Disarm you. If you have the Deft Cooperation feat and critically succeed on a check to Aid an ally's attack roll or skill check, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus from Deft Cooperation (instead of a +1 bonus)"

name: Regional Specialty
question: Should feats that create a consumable for OTHERS (here: alchemical food from Morning Side Dishes) put a star on the crafter's own saves? Five always-visible entries may be noise if the character usually hands the food to allies.
evidence: "Each element has an immediate benefit and a +3 item bonus to certain saves that lasts for 1 hour after the food is consumed. The item bonus increases to +4 if the alchemical item is 18th level or higher."

name: Prepare Elemental Medicine
question: Does the app want granted-to-another-creature bonuses in this registry at all, and can a character use Prepare Elemental Medicine on themselves (the text says 'a creature' and never forbids self, but consistently says 'your patient')?
evidence: "prepare an excellent elemental medicine that grants the recipient a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against the affliction" / "**Success** As critical success, but the bonus is +1." / "**Critical Failure** ... imposes a –1 circumstance penalty to saves against the affliction."

name: Cardinal Guardians
question: Does targetKind 'spell' mean spell attack roll, spell DC, or both? This feat needs attack-only.
evidence: "you gain a +2 status bonus to your spell attack modifier against that creature with spells granted by any of your other apparitions ... These benefits last until the end of your next turn."

name: Aegis for the Innocent
question: Can Aegis for the Innocent target the exemplar themselves ('a willing creature within the bright light of your nimbus')? If yes, the +1 status AC may star the owner's sheet; if it is ally-only, it must not.
evidence: "Select a willing creature within the bright light of your nimbus ... The target gains a +1 status bonus to AC." — barrier "lasts for 1 minute, or until you Dismiss it"; Requirements: "Your nimbus is active."

name: Stoked Flame Stance
question: HH's exclusive-stance manager (content.stances / Character.activeStance) already injects a stance's speed change into the derived numbers while the stance is toggled on. Should stance feats also appear as situational stars, or would that double-report the same bonus?
evidence: While in Stoked Flame Stance, you gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed. If you have incredible movement, increase the benefit from incredible movement to a +15-foot status bonus plus 5 feet for every 4 levels beyond 3rd.

name: Soulforger Dedication
question: Should a choice-driven feat list every essence power's bonus on the star, or only the one the character actually chose? Showing all nine is noisy; showing only the chosen one requires the situational lookup to read the stored essence-power choice, which it currently cannot do (it is keyed by feat id alone).
evidence: Deep-Seeded Fear: 'You gain a +2 status bonus to your Intimidation checks ... when Demoralizing foes who can perceive your armament's essence form.' Heroic Heart: 'You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, Perception checks, skill checks, and saves.' Magical Resilience: 'You gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws and AC against spells.' Reflecting Spirit: 'You gain a +2 status bonus to AC against physical ranged attacks.' Planar Pain: 'Attacks with the weapon deal this type of damage instead of their physical damage with a +2 status bonus to the damage.'

name: Vehicle Mechanic Dedication
question: Which stat does HH use for a vehicle 'piloting check'? PF2e resolves it with whatever skill the vehicle lists (commonly Piloting Lore, Nature, or Sailing Lore), so there is no single skill key to flag - should this be skill 'all', a lore key, or skipped until vehicles carry a piloting-skill field?
evidence: Due to your amazing customizations and adjustments, pilots gain a +1 circumstance bonus to any piloting checks they make to control your signature vehicle. If you are a master in Crafting, this bonus increases to +2.

name: Black Powder Boost
question: Leap/jump distance is not one of the eleven target kinds. Should jump-distance bonuses map onto 'speed' with wording that says 'jump distance', gain a dedicated jump target, or be skipped entirely? (Same question applies to Reach for the Stars.)
evidence: You Leap and discharge your firearm to add a +10-foot status bonus to the distance traveled.

name: Reach for the Stars
question: Same as Black Powder Boost: jump/Leap distance has no target kind. Map it onto 'speed' with explicit wording, add a jump target, or skip these entries?
evidence: For each dose of black powder or piece of firearm ammunition you spend in addition to your shot, you add another 10 feet to the height or distance of your Leap, to a maximum of 5 boosts (a +50-foot status bonus).

name: Artillerist Dedication
question: Only Repair is a defined skill action (Crafting). Load, Aim and move a siege weapon are crew actions with no fixed skill in HH - should the star flag Crafting alone, or should there be a stat-less 'siege weapon crew checks' note?
evidence: If you're serving on a siege weapon crew, you and all other members gain a +2 circumstance bonus to any checks to Load, Aim, move, or Repair the weapon.

name: Explosive Entry
question: Confirm the exact key HH uses for Engineering Lore in a situational skill target - 'lore:engineering' is assumed here from the doc comment's 'a lore:* key'.
evidence: you can attempt an Engineering Lore check to Force Open the target. If a bomb would add an item bonus to attack rolls, add that item bonus to your Engineering Lore check.

name: Whirlwind Stance
question: Stance-gated bonuses that the stance manager already applies (acBonus / dexCap / speed on content.stances) — should they ALSO get a situational star, or is the active-stance toggle the whole story? Whirlwind Stance's own extra requirement (the staff must have the parry trait) is only carried as prose in the stance `note` and is never checked.
evidence: "**Requirements** You are wielding your staff, which must have the parry trait. ... You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC as long as you remain in this stance."

name: Explosive Death Drop
question: core.json's text for explosive-death-drop reads "Roll an check against your target's Fortitude DC" — the skill name is missing (the printed feat says 'Roll an Athletics check'). Confirm the target is Athletics, and decide whether the dropped word should be fixed in the data (it is a display defect players will see, independent of this registry).
evidence: "Roll an check against your target's Fortitude DC. You take a -1 circumstance penalty to your check if the target is one size larger than you and a -3 circumstance penalty if it's larger than that. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your check if the target is one size smaller than you and a +3 circumstance bonus if it's smaller than that."

name: Hydraulic Maneuvers
question: Hydraulic Maneuvers grants NO bonus — it suppresses item bonuses and body-related circumstance bonuses and upgrades a critical failure to a failure. Should the situational registry carry non-bonus modifiers like this (a star that warns rather than promises), or should it hold only actual bonuses and leave suppressions out?
evidence: "If the next action you take is an Athletics check to Disarm, Shove, or Trip, that action has a range of 15 feet. You don't receive any item bonuses to that check or any circumstance bonuses related to your physical body, but if you roll a critical failure on that Athletics check, you get a failure instead."

name: Gravelands Herbalist
question: Two calls for you. (a) Should a consumable's bonus be registered on the FEAT that unlocks it, or left to the item lane once items can carry markers? Registering it here stars Stealth for anyone holding the feat even when they haven't eaten any soup — the feat by itself grants nothing. (b) core.json's items/lastwall-soup-greater says "+3 item bonus" while this feat says the Greater version grants +4 — one of the two records is wrong; which is authoritative?
evidence: Feat: "At 10th level, you can make Lastwall Soup (Improved) that grants a +3 item bonus. At 18th level, you can make Lastwall Soup (Greater) that grants a +4 item bonus..." The bonus itself is defined on the consumable — items/lastwall-soup: "you gain a +2 item bonus to Stealth checks and DCs against undead"; items/lastwall-soup-improved: "+3 item bonus to Stealth checks and DCs against undead".

name: Bloc Tactics
question: Can the character be one of their own Bloc Tactics targets (i.e. disguise themselves), or is the feat allies-only? The text says only "you can select a number of targets equal to half your level" — if the character can't be a target, both bonuses are ally-only and this record should be needsEngineWork instead.
evidence: "You disguise the targets to hide their identities, which gives them a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through their disguises... giving the targets a +3 status bonus to saving throws against them [smoke, fumes, and inhaled substances]."

name: Decree of Prosperity
question: For the Mythic-Point version, does the speaking character count as one of "every individual within a 10-mile radius" and so get the +2 status bonus to Earn Income themselves? If yes, this should also carry a skill/'all' entry limited to Earn Income checks.
evidence: "all your knights who hear your decree treat failures (but not critical failures) on non-attack skill checks as successes for 1 minute" and "Each individual receives a +2 status bonus to all checks to Earn Income".

name: Mask of The 12th Step
question: Should the marker hang off this feat, or off the silver Razmiri mask item? The feat only lets you Craft/upgrade the mask — the +2 item bonus is printed as a property of the mask, so a character who takes the feat but isn't wearing the mask should show nothing.
evidence: "A Silver Razmiri Mask grants a +2 item bonus to Deception checks to Lie or Feint, is a 10th-level item..."

name: Mask of The 15th Step
question: Same as Mask of the 12th Step: should the marker live on the feat or on the gold Razmiri mask item? The bonus only exists while the mask is worn.
evidence: "A gold *Razmiri mask* grants a +3 item bonus to Deception checks to Lie or Feint, is a 14th-level item..."

name: Living God
question: Same as the other Razmiri mask feats: marker on the feat or on the porcelain mask item? Also, should the apex Charisma increase be routed to the existing apex-item handling rather than appearing here at all?
evidence: "A Porcelain Razmiri Mask grants a +4 item bonus to Deception checks to Lie or Feint, is an 18th-level item, and is an apex item that increases your Charisma modifier by 1 or increases it to +4, whichever would give you a higher score."

name: Uncanny Bombs
question: Should target-side reductions (e.g. "reduce the target's cover bonus by 1") be surfaced as situational markers on the player's Strike, or excluded because no actual bonus is applied to this character?
evidence: "you reduce any circumstance bonus to the target's AC from cover by 1, and you automatically succeed at the flat check when targeting a concealed creature"

name: Come and Get Me
question: Should situational DRAWBACKS (e.g. "damage rolls against you gain +2", "you are off-guard") be surfaced with a marker too, or is the star strictly for bonuses that help the character?
evidence: "Until your rage ends, you are off-guard, and damage rolls against you gain a +2 circumstance bonus."

name: Dragon Transformation
question: Are polymorph-form statistics (Dragon Transformation / Dragon Form) already surfaced by the alternate-forms system? If so, should this record be excluded from situational bonuses to avoid duplicate display?
evidence: "At 18th level, you gain a +20-foot status bonus to your fly Speed, your damage bonus with dragon Strikes increases to +12, and you gain a +14 status bonus to your Dragon Breath damage."

name: Mountain Stance
question: For "a +2 circumstance bonus to any defenses against Reposition, Shove, Trip and other forced movement", should the marker sit on all three saves, on Fortitude only (the DC those maneuvers actually target), or on AC as well?
evidence: "While in Mountain Stance, you gain a +4 item bonus to AC and a +2 circumstance bonus to any defenses against Reposition, Shove, Trip, and other forced movement effects."

name: Medic Dedication
question: Should healing you deliver to OTHERS (Battle Medicine / Treat Wounds targets) be surfaced on your own sheet at all — e.g. as a reminder chip on the Medicine skill rather than a star on your HP?
evidence: "When you succeed with Battle Medicine or Treat Wounds, the target gains a circumstance bonus to the number of Hit Points they regain equal to 5 HP at DC 20, 10 HP at DC 30, or 15 HP at DC 40."

name: Incredible Scout
question: Scout normally gives "you and your allies" +1, but Incredible Scout's text upgrades only "your allies" to +2 — do you want to read that literally (scout keeps +1, nothing to show on their sheet), or treat the scout as included and star their Perception-for-initiative?
evidence: "When using the Scout exploration activity, you grant your allies a +2 circumstance bonus to their initiative rolls instead of a +1 circumstance bonus."

name: Signature Crafting
question: Should a crafted item that rolled the 'Skillful' quirk (+1 item bonus to one type of skill check) be authorable on the item itself via the Homebrew/item editor, so it reaches the sheet through the item lane rather than the feat lane?
evidence: "Any benefit a creature gains from an item quirk applies only while the creature wears the item (for a worn item) or holds it (for a held item)." — the only numeric quirk is "| 10 | Skillful | The item grants a +1 item bonus to one type of skill checks. |"

name: Perfected Gamtu
question: Model this as a situational star ('while wearing your gamtu'), or as a real item bonus folded into the Stealth total — and if the latter, does the gamtu need to exist as an inventory item so item-bonus stacking is resolved correctly?
evidence: "Your gamtu now grants its wearer a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks when worn"

name: Unwavering Guide
question: Unlike Incredible Scout this says "your party", which normally includes the scout — confirm the character themselves gets the +2 (that is the reading authored here), and confirm you want initiative bonuses to keep riding on the Perception stat rather than getting a real initiative target kind.
evidence: "When you Scout, you grant your party a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls instead of the normal +1."

name: Guided Skill
question: Does Guided Skill grant the +2 status bonus to all four skills at once, or does the player pick one of the four? The 'A, B, C, or D' phrasing reads as 'any check that uses one of these four' (which is how I've entered it), but a per-use choice is a defensible reading — confirm before shipping four stars.
evidence: "For the next 10 minutes, you gain a +2 status bonus to checks made using Acrobatics, Occultism, Stealth, or Survival."

name: Psychic Duelist Dedication
question: Psychic duels are a subsystem the app does not model at all, and every benefit here is gated on being inside one. Should duel-only bonuses be surfaced as stars on ordinary stats (risking a player reading them as generally applicable), suppressed entirely, or shown only under an explicit 'psychic duel' mode?
evidence: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your initiative rolls for psychic duels... Mind Mace: You gain a status bonus to mental damage with spells you cast equal to the spell's rank.

name: Ward Slumber
question: 'up to eight creatures within 30 feet of you' — does the warder count as one of the eight (i.e. does the caster get the +4 themselves)? I read yes, but the text never says so explicitly, and the answer decides whether this record stars the character's own saves at all.
evidence: All creatures affected by the ritual gain a +4 status bonus on saving throws against Nightmare or other effects influencing dreams... until your next daily preparations.

name: Rose Warden Dedication
question: The second clause says 'saving throws against being confused, controlled, grabbed, immobilized, or restrained'. Should that star all three saves, or should it be narrowed to Will (the save those effects most often use)? I chose 'all' to avoid missing a case, at the cost of a broader-looking marker.
evidence: When you get a critical success to Lie to a figure of authority, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude DC and saving throws against being confused, controlled, grabbed, immobilized, or restrained by that figure of authority for 24 hours.

name: Infiltrator's Elixir
question: Should one-use consumables whose bonus lasts only while the effect runs (10 minutes here) put a permanent star on the Deception row just for sitting in inventory, or should consumable bonuses only be surfaced from the item entry / an active-effect toggle?
evidence: "You gain a +4 status bonus to your Deception DC to avoid others seeing through your disguise, and you add your level to this DC even if untrained."

name: Aeon Stone (Polished Pebble)
question: For bonuses written as "saves and DCs against X" (Grapple/Swallow), do you want them anchored on the matching save row with a DC note, or suppressed until the sheet displays Fortitude DC?
evidence: "granting a +1 item bonus to saves and DCs against attempts to grapple or swallow you"

name: Lead by Example
question: Should activity-internal PENALTIES (here, the –2 circumstance on the Lead by Example Strike) be recorded in this registry at all, or is it strictly a bonuses table? Several feats in this batch (Lead by Example, Lesson of the Broken Wing) hinge on that call.
evidence: "Make a melee or ranged Strike with a –2 circumstance penalty. On a hit, the next ally to target the same creature with a Strike gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their attack roll."

name: Vellumis Excision
question: Do we want a star on the character's saves for an area effect they only benefit from when they choose to stand inside it, or should self-inclusive area buffs be left off the sheet?
evidence: "any living creatures in the area when you Sustain the spell gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against curses, diseases, and poisons for 1 round"

name: Pennant of Victory
question: For 'attack and damage rolls' phrasing, do we mark strikeAttack/strikeDamage only, or also the 'spell' target so spell attack rolls show the bonus?
evidence: "You and all allies within the aura of your commander's banner gain a +4 status bonus to attack and damage rolls, a +10-foot status bonus to all your Speeds, and 40 temporary Hit Points. These benefits last until the start of your next turn."

Should hireling records mark PC stats at all, and if so should the informant/counselor and normal/expert variants be split into separate records (or a picker) so only the purchased variant stars?
evidence: "An informant automatically Aids you on attempts to Gather Information and Recall Knowledge about your specific location, granting you a +1 circumstance bonus to such checks."

name: Fulcrum Lenses
question: This single record bundles FOUR distinct magic items (Crimson, Ebon, Emerald and Ochre Fulcrum Lens), each with its own invested bonuses. Attaching all eight bonuses to one id would star a character for lenses they do not own. Should the record be split into four items (recommended), or should the lenses get an effect-choice picker like aon-energy-robe's robe-energy choice?
evidence: "You gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws against fear effects and a +2 item bonus to your melee Strike damage (this increases to a +4 item bonus to damage if the melee Strike is a jaws attack)." (Crimson lens)

name: Hopeful Athamaru
question: Should ally-facing auras be surfaced on the granting character's own sheet at all (e.g. as an informational note on the saves row, or in a separate "auras you project" section), or excluded from the situational registry entirely because they never modify this character's numbers?
evidence: "You have a 10-foot aura that grants any ally in it a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against fear; this is an emotion and mental effect."

name: Tsukumogami Poppet
question: For a bonus whose size depends on another record (+2, or +3 with Helpful Poppet), should the registry entry carry a single text string showing both values, or should the engine gain a way to express "+2, or +3 if the character has feat X"?
evidence: "You're trained in this skill, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Aid with this skill. If you take the Helpful Poppet feat, the bonus increases to +3."

name: Born of Animal
question: Should conditional value REPLACEMENTS (Speed set to 30 ft) be listed in the situational registry alongside typed bonuses, or is the registry strictly for '+N type' modifiers?
evidence: "You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Intimidation checks against animals and beasts" (Humanoid Form); "If you have both hands free, you can increase your Speed to 30 feet as you run on all fours" (Yaoguai Form)

name: Born of Celestial
question: Does Heroes Heaven model yaoguai Humanoid Form vs Yaoguai Form as a toggle? If not, should form-gated flat bonuses (this +1 Religion, and Born of Item's +1 Lore) be folded into the totals as unconditional instead of starred?
evidence: "**Humanoid Form** Fragments of divine memory still litter your mind. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Religion checks."

name: Born of Item
question: Same form question as Born of Celestial - plus: can the situational lookup read a heritage's chosen Lore so `lore:*` resolves to the actual skill?
evidence: "**Humanoid Form** ... You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the Lore skill you obtained through this heritage."

name: Mechanical Symbiosis
question: Where should the GM-assigned entity skill live - a free-choice field on the background (like the existing Lore free-text input) so the star lands on the right skill?
evidence: "Any time you attempt a skill check for the entity's skill, the GM can offer you a +1 circumstance bonus to the check, as though the entity were Aiding you. If you accept but fail the check, the entity clenches up and you are Stunned 1"

name: Harrow-Chosen
question: For a 'choose one of Fort/Ref/Will' bonus, is starring all three saves acceptable, or should the registry support a 'one of your choice' marker so the sheet does not imply all three are boosted at once?
evidence: "**True match**: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to a saving throw of your choice (Fortitude, Reflex, or Will) for 1 minute."; "**Misaligned**: You gain a +5-foot circumstance bonus to your Speeds for 1 minute."; "**Unmatched**: You gain temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level."

name: Close Ties
question: The Family/Foundling adjustments are shared boilerplate duplicated onto all four Willowshore backgrounds and are opt-in. Should Bickering's +1 status to saves be modelled as a separate selectable option (like a background adjustment choice) rather than attached to these four background ids?
evidence: Base background grants no typed bonus (Diplomacy, Tea Lore, Specialty Crafting, friendly NPC). The only typed bonus in the record is the shared adjustment block: "**Bickering:** ... Whenever your sibling(s) critically fail a significant skill check or attack roll and you witness their failure, you gain a +1 status bonus to your saving throws until the end of your next turn"

evidence: Base background grants no typed bonus (Religion, Art Lore, Oddity Identification). Only the shared adjustment block carries one: "**Bickering:** ... you gain a +1 status bonus to your saving throws until the end of your next turn"

name: Southbank Traditionalist
question: Should the opt-in 'Family: Bickering' / 'Foundling' background adjustments (shared boilerplate on all Season of Ghosts backgrounds) be modelled at all? If yes they need their own selectable ids (e.g. 'adjustment-bickering' -> +1 status to all saves until the end of your next turn when a sibling PC critically fails a check you witness), not an entry keyed to the background.
evidence: The background's own grant is only "You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Farming Lore skill. You gain the Hobnobber feat." The only typed bonus anywhere in the text is inside the shared Season-of-Ghosts adjustments sidebar: "Bickering: ... you gain a +1 status bonus to your saving throws until the end of your next turn".

name: Willowshore Urchin
question: Same question as Southbank Traditionalist — model the opt-in Season of Ghosts background adjustments as separate selectable ids, or leave them out entirely?
evidence: The background's own grant is only "You're trained in the Athletics skill and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Charming Liar feat." The one typed bonus in the text is the shared adjustments sidebar: "Bickering: ... you gain a +1 status bonus to your saving throws until the end of your next turn".

name: Haunted
question: Until a 'haunting entity's skill' choice field exists, is starring ALL skills with the wording above acceptable, or should this record be left out rather than over-mark the sheet?
evidence: "Any time you attempt a skill check for the entity's skill, the GM can offer you a +1 circumstance bonus to the check, as though the entity were Aiding you. If you accept but fail the check, you are Frightened 2 (Frightened 4 on a critical failure)."

name: Runelord Researcher
question: Is a `when` string this long acceptable in the stat detail panel, or should the second bonus be trimmed to "against the effect type of the school you chose during daily preparations" with the table left to the background description?
evidence: "When you Recall Knowledge about runelords or ancient Thassilon, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the check." and "during your daily preparations, you can choose one of the following schools of Thassilonian rune magic to focus your mind on, gaining a +1 status bonus to saving throws against the listed effect for the next 8 hours."

name: Reborn Soul
question: Same over-marking call as Haunted: accept a star on every skill for GM-offered bonuses, or restrict these to the character's chosen Lore skills once that data is readable?
evidence: "The GM can offer you a +1 circumstance bonus on skill checks with either of these Lore skills or on other skill checks that echo your past life. If you accept but fail the check, you're Stupefied 1 for 1 minute"

name: Shotalashu
question: Should one-time acquisition / downtime prerequisite checks (here: +4 circumstance to the DC 21 Occultism check to bond with a shotalashu, for characters with telepathy) ever surface as situational bonuses, or are only in-play bonuses in scope?
evidence: "Any creature with telepathic capabilities, such as telepathy, touch telepathy, empathic sense, or the ability to cast spells such as telepathy, gains a +4 circumstance bonus to this check." — 'this check' being the "DC 21 Occultism check to establish a telepathic link" needed to acquire the companion.
